text.en: Whisper is row 24 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Speech area.
text.zh: Whisper 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 24 行，所属领域为“语音”。

text.en: The annual table associates Whisper with “Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Whisper 与论文《Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Alec Radford, Jong Wook Kim, Ilya Sutskever”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 亚历克·拉德福德、金钟旭、伊利亚·苏茨克维；官方英文原文为“Alec Radford, Jong Wook Kim, Ilya Sutskever”。

text.en: Whisper uses weakly supervised multilingual multitask sequence-to-sequence training.
text.zh: Whisper 采用弱监督多语种多任务序列到序列训练。

text.en: Experts generally treat Whisper as a turning point in open, general-purpose speech recognition because its released models made robust multilingual transcription widely accessible. Its influence also extends to speech interfaces for later multimodal and conversational systems.
text.zh: 专家通常把 Whisper 视为开放通用语音识别的重要转折点，因为公开模型让稳健的多语种转写更容易获得。它的影响还延伸到后来多模态系统和对话系统的语音入口。
